unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Trabajo, estudios y sociedad: repaso integrado
theory.explanation: Integra el lenguaje de las unidades anteriores para describir experiencias, responsabilidades, decisiones y planes. Elige la estructura gramatical según la referencia temporal y la intención comunicativa, y utiliza conectores para enlazar las ideas con claridad.
theory.tip: Antes de elegir la estructura, identifica qué quieres comunicar: experiencia, obligación, hipótesis, resultado o plan.

content.passage: This year, a group of adult learners has completed several projects. They have improved their communication skills and learned to work with different people. Although some tasks were challenging, the group found practical solutions. One student said that if she had more time, she would volunteer at a local centre. By the end of the course, everyone will have prepared a short presentation about their progress and future goals.

items.prompt: Describe a skill you have improved this year.
items.modelAnswer: I have improved my presentation skills this year by speaking at team meetings. I used to read every sentence from my notes, but now I look at the audience and explain the main points in my own words.

items.prompt: Explain what you would do if you had more free time.
items.modelAnswer: If I had more free time, I would join a local sports club and volunteer at the library. I would also spend more time learning languages because I enjoy meeting people from different backgrounds.

items.prompt: Talk about a rule or process that must be followed.
items.modelAnswer: In our office, everyone must follow the process for storing customer information. Files should be saved in the secure system, and personal details must not be shared with people who do not need them.

items.prompt: Report a request someone made to you.
items.modelAnswer: My manager asked me to prepare a short summary of the meeting and send it to the team. I agreed to do it before the end of the day and included the main decisions and deadlines.

items.prompt: Describe a challenge you overcame although it was difficult.
items.modelAnswer: I completed a difficult training course although I had very little free time. I studied during lunch breaks and asked my family to give me quiet time in the evenings. Passing the final assessment made the effort worthwhile.

items.prompt: Talk about something you are used to doing at work or study.
items.modelAnswer: I'm used to checking my calendar before I start work. It helps me remember meetings and plan the time I need for each task. I also review tomorrow's schedule before leaving the office.

items.prompt: Explain what you will have completed by the end of the year.
items.modelAnswer: By the end of the year, I will have completed my professional course and prepared a portfolio of my work. I hope to have received feedback from my tutor and used it to improve.

items.prompt: Describe how practice helps people become more confident.
items.modelAnswer: Practice helps people become more confident because it makes difficult tasks feel familiar. When I rehearse a presentation, I can focus on the message instead of worrying about every word.

Feedback is useful because it shows what is working well and what needs improvement. Good feedback gives examples and suggests practical next steps. It helps people develop rather than simply judge their performance.

items.prompt: Summarise your progress and future goals.
items.modelAnswer: This year I have become more organised and confident when communicating at work. I want to improve my leadership skills and continue studying English. By the end of next year, I hope to have completed another qualification.

content.audioTranscript: A: How have you found the course? B: Very useful. I've developed new skills and gained more confidence. A: What has helped you most? B: The practical experience and regular practice have made a difference. A: Have you shared your opinions in class? B: Yes, and we've solved several problems together. A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
